description_en: Deletes a scheduled scaling plan. You can call this operation only for AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode for Cluster Edition
description_zh: 调用DeleteElasticPlan接口删除分时弹性计划。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
kebab_example: aliyun adb delete-elastic-plan --db-cluster-id am-bp1xxxxxxxx47 --elastic-plan-name test --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612241.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612241.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html operation to query the names of scaling plans
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612271.html接口可以查看集群的弹性计划名称
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name
